suggestions: I'm grateful for the quiet stillness right after Fajr, giving me a peaceful head start before the morning standup.
I'm thankful for finally resolving that tricky race condition bug after hours of deep-dive debugging.
I'm grateful for a warm cup of teh tarik and roti canai during a much-needed lunch break with teammates.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a stable job that allows me to build useful things and support my family.
I'm grateful for a Friday production deployment that went smoothly with zero emergency rollbacks.
I'm thankful for the cooling afternoon rain outside my window after a long session at my desk.
I'm grateful for senior engineers who take the time to give thoughtful, encouraging feedback on my pull requests.
I'm thankful for late-night mamak sessions with close friends where we can unwind and talk about life beyond work.
I'm grateful for the ability to log off on time and walk over to the surau for Maghrib prayer.
I'm thankful for that deeply satisfying feeling when all unit tests pass green on the first run.
I'm grateful for my parents' continuous doa and their caring messages during intense project sprint weeks.
I'm thankful for the flexibility to work remotely and skip the morning highway gridlock.
I'm grateful for an icy kopi ais that gave me the energy boost to power through the afternoon slump.
I'm thankful for well-written documentation and clear API specs that saved me hours of frustration today.
I'm grateful for the barakah in simple daily moments, from a good chat with a colleague to finishing my tasks on schedule.
